limited_individual_pilot.description: One researcher using a private local workspace.
limited_individual_pilot.release_decision: allowed as a limited pilot when local validation is recorded and limitations are explicit

broad_individual_release.description: Multiple researchers can install and use independent local workspaces.
broad_individual_release.release_decision: blocked until install, docs, backup/restore, parser degradation, privacy, performance, and release notes are validated

git_shared_research_release.description: Researchers exchange Git repositories or workspace snapshots and safely import selected artifacts.
git_shared_research_release.release_decision: blocked until repository hygiene, merge dry-run/apply, provenance, and post-merge rebuild validation are complete

future_multi_user_platform.description: Shared database, service deployment, SSO/RBAC, real-time collaboration, hosted UI, and department operations.
future_multi_user_platform.release_decision: deferred future product line; not a blocker for the current individual Git-sharing release

contract_limitations: This file is a release gate contract for the individual Git-sharing release target.
Generated, parser, LLM, benchmark, derivation, readiness, merge, and validation artifacts remain review material until explicitly approved.
Future multi-user platform work is deferred and must not block the current individual local release.
